chart.name: Change in rows (%)

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart.

publishLabelOptions.displayName: Change in past week live rows
publishLabelOptions.label: C

chart.programText:
A = data('postgresql.rows', filter=filter('state', 'live')).mean(over='1h').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).timeshift('1w').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((A-B)/B*100).publish(label='C')

chart.name: # Operations/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('postgresql.operations', filter=filter('operation', 'ins'), rollup='rate').sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='A')
B = data('postgresql.operations', filter=filter('operation', 'upd'), rollup='rate').sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='B')
C = data('postgresql.operations', filter=filter('operation', 'del'), rollup='rate').sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Change in blocks read (%)

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart.

chart.programText:
A = data('postgresql.blocks_read', filter=filter('source', 'heap_read'), rollup='delta').sum().mean(over='1h').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('postgresql.blocks_read', filter=filter('source', 'idx_read'), rollup='delta').sum().mean(over='1h').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A).timeshift('1w').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (B).timeshift('1w').publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = ((A-C)/C*100).publish(label='E')
F = ((B-D)/D*100).publish(label='F')
